about: The eight view tools as the server describes them to the model (server/src/adapters/claude.ts, ClaudeViewer): the description and parameter schema AG Studio 3.0.0's own tools sent from the dashboard (captured from POST /api/view on the Behind-the-scenes page, Oct 30 2026), with each per-page widget id list loosened to a plain string, and configure_widget (which the browser does not list today) written by hand. The browser's own copies are never forwarded: a request names tools, the server supplies these. add_widget's type list keeps only Goose's own cards: the page has no configure_widget, so a stock widget could only come out empty (Nov 5).

view_schema.description: View the available data schema - fieldsets and their fields with types. Always call this before creating widgets or writing queries so you know which field IDs exist.

view_page.description: View the current page state: widget positions, page layout config, active page filters, layout/filter issues, and per-widget health summaries.

execute_query.description:
Execute a query against the data source.
Two modes:
- aggregation: group by dimensions with aggregated measures (sum, avg, count, etc.)
- projection: return raw rows with selected columns (no aggregation)

Supports joins, filters, sorting, and pagination.

Aliases ('as'): every 'as' value in the query must be unique across dimensions,
measures, projections, and windows — they share one output namespace. Reusing a
name (e.g. setting 'as: "total_revenue"' on both a dimension and a measure) is
rejected with validationAliasCollision; pick distinct names per output.

add_widget.description: Add a widget to the grid. Position is 0-indexed.

configure_widget.description: Configure one widget already on this page (its own settings, patched).

widgetId.description: The id of a widget on this page (view_page lists them).

position_widget.description: Move and/or resize a widget on the grid. All position fields are optional - omitted fields preserve current values. 0-indexed.

widgetId.description: The id of a widget on this page (view_page lists them).

add_page_filter.description:
Add a single page-level filter (appended to the page filter list).
Supports comparison, text, set (isIn), null/blank, relative-date (inRelativeRange), and rank
operators - see the field type for the available set. For a top/bottom-N filter, use operator "rank"
on the numeric field to rank by, with value [topN, bottomN] (null for the unused bound).

value.description: Top/bottom bounds [topN, bottomN]: keeps the topN highest and/or bottomN lowest rows ranked by this field; null for the unused bound (top 10 = [10, null]).
